scenarios.single-free-space: A single pedestrian starts on the horizontal goal line. Clearances are unavailable, no correction occurs, and every engine must progress toward the goal.
scenarios.single-at-goal: A pedestrian starts inside the closed goal disk and must remain stationary without late avoidance onset.
scenarios.pairwise-separating: The Conditioned Riemannian closing gate removes the separating interaction, so its command equals unobstructed goal steering.
scenarios.pairwise-exact-symmetric: The initial state is exactly mirror symmetric. The proposed controller must not invent a lateral direction.
scenarios.goal-projection-head-on: Goal steering creates a raw overlap that shared positional projection repairs; raw and corrected clearances must remain distinct.
scenarios.correction-disabled-head-on: With correction disabled, pre- and post-correction positions and contact measurements must be identical.
scenarios.wall-approach: Single-agent wall clearance is finite while agent-agent clearance remains null; wall and agent penetration fields remain separate.

machineChecks: agent IDs and physical state are continuous
native external engines report zero positional correction
free-space command directions and progress have the expected signs
separating Riemannian commands equal free goal steering
symmetric Riemannian first commands have zero lateral component
Goal+Projection raw overlap is visible before projection
disabled correction leaves pre/post states equal
wall and agent safety fields are not conflated
